stories.title: After six months, the Iran war has reached a costly stalemate
stories.reason: Washington's counter-blockade and Tehran's near-total closure of the Strait of Hormuz have settled into a dangerous standoff, with mediated talks stalled and no side willing to appear to concede.

stories.title: Federal judge blocks Trump's latest order limiting birthright citizenship
stories.reason: A judge called the new order 'almost certainly unconstitutional' months after the Supreme Court struck down Trump's original attempt, setting up another round of litigation over the 14th Amendment.

stories.title: US pushes hands-off AI regulation at G20 while the EU moves toward new law
stories.reason: Washington's 'Carolina Principles' pitch for minimal AI rules, backed by Zuckerberg, Musk and Hassabis, puts the US on a collision course with Brussels just a day after the EU classified ChatGPT as a search engine.

stories.title: ChatGPT Health adds Epic integration, giving clinicians access to 325 million patients' records
stories.reason: The read-only integration lets doctors query ChatGPT using a patient's real appointment notes, labs and medications, a significant expansion of AI into frontline clinical workflows.

stories.title: US private payrolls rose just 38,000 in August, weakest pace since January
stories.reason: ADP's report came in well below the 48,000 economists expected, with manufacturing shedding 17,000 jobs, adding to evidence of a cooling labor market ahead of the Fed's September meeting.

stories.title: ChatGPT's ad business hits $1 billion annualized revenue in under 200 days
stories.reason: The rapid ramp-up, now expanding self-serve access to Europe, India and the Middle East, shows OpenAI moving fast to diversify revenue beyond subscriptions as it burns through billions in compute spending.

stories.title: DRC Ebola vaccine trials set to begin by November as death toll passes 3,000
stories.reason: Three candidate vaccines from IAVI, Moderna and Oxford are being fast-tracked against a Bundibugyo-strain outbreak that has no approved vaccine, offering the first real response tool in the deadliest Ebola epidemic on record.

stories.title: At least 25 top Pentagon officials have departed under Defense Secretary Hegseth
stories.reason: Army Secretary Dan Driscoll's resignation pushed the tally of fired or departed generals, admirals and civilian defense leaders past two dozen, deepening questions about turmoil atop the military during an active war.
